correctness.rationale: The independent proof reconstruction starts from the correlated Gaussian orthant integral at a=-Phi^{-1}(u),b=-Phi^{-1}(v). With b/a->1, positive derivative coefficients gamma_1,gamma_2 yield a uniform relative error O(a^-2+b^-2) after exponential rescaling. Mills-ratio subtraction for t=log(u/v)=O(log log(1/u)) gives Q(a,b)-Q(a,a)~2t/(1+rho); the ratio is K_rho*L^{-alpha}*exp(alpha*t)*(1+o(1)), uniformly on bounded logarithmic wedges. The conditional Gaussian h_u(t)=Phi((Phi^{-1}(u)-rho Phi^{-1}(t))/sqrt(1-rho^2)) strictly decreases with t; thus G(u,v)/v decreases from 1 to the diagonal comparison and gives a unique crossing, not just two test signs. Independent Gauss-orthant 1D quadrature at rho=.3,.5,.7 and u=10^-10 brackets c_rho by c_rho/4 and 4c_rho. Finite quadrature is corroboration only. Endpoints rho=0,1 and multi-parameter uniformity are excluded.
